# simpleaudit

LLM safety auditing framework

> https://github.com/kelkalot/simpleaudit

## Guides

- [Quickstart](https://SushantGautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/guides/quickstart/): Run your first audit using the CLI or Python API with a minimal example.
- [Installation](https://SushantGautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/guides/installation/): Install dependencies and configure environment variables for API keys.
- [Architecture](https://SushantGautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/guides/architecture/): Overview of the audit pipeline: scenarios, judges, and result aggregation.
- [Key Ideas](https://SushantGautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/guides/key-ideas/): Core concepts including cross-judging, reframing, and repeated experiments.

- [SKILL.md](https://SushantGautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/SKILL.md): Agent skill for generating, maintaining, and validating this project's documentation.
